message.content: ATP synthase (also known as Complex V) is the enzyme that produces ATP in mitochondria. It uses the proton gradient generated by the electron transport chain to drive the phosphorylation of ADP to ATP as protons flow back into the matrix through the enzyme’s F₀ channel. This chemiosmotic coupling is the final step of oxidative phosphorylation, generating the bulk of the cell’s ATP.
